args.question: Requesting change-manager approval to deploy checkout-api v2.3.2 (hotfix) to all production regions. Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Checked deployment history** — confirmed v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so change-manager approval was required.
2. **Obtained change-manager approval** for the v2.3.2 production deployment (approved).
3. **Deployed checkout-api v2.3.2** — rolled out successfully to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), status `rolled_out`.
4. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** — "checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions," recording the change; on-call was paged and the incident is open for tracking.

Note: the incident description says on-call was paged — this may be expected behavior for incident creation, but if paging for a routine hotfix recording is undesirable, you may want to close or downgrade the incident.
